summary: yakuza0 ships hardcoded non-registry exfiltration endpoint and child_process+HTTP shell in CLI/proxy code
details: The package's CLI entry (cli/index.js) contains a hardcoded network destination at https://registry-pxnpm.rdc.nfjbill.ren, referenced alongside process.versions collection and multiple fetch() call sites (lines 513, 554, 623). The server/proxy modules (csrf.js, tire.js) import child_process together with HTTP primitives and issue outbound POST/GET traffic and shell curl invocations (tire.js line 45, 261, 404; csrf.js line 83). The endpoint hostname does not match any legitimate npm registry or vendor infrastructure and follows a typosquat-style pattern of a real registry domain. The combination of a hardcoded non-registry host, host-identifier reads (process.versions), fetch-based exfiltration primitives, and shell command execution paths in code that runs when the CLI is invoked is consistent with data collection and command execution against the installer rather than legitimate package functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
